purpose: Original synthesized non-speech UI sound cues for mobile app testing; genre associations are creative, not measured popularity ranking

behavior.app_event: Advance to next short cue (cycle index modulo 12)
behavior.preview: User-triggered play/pause loop through 12 cues with ~160 ms gap
behavior.restore: Back returns to prior screen; preference persists
behavior.mute: None disables all effects; respect system silent/DND
behavior.reduced_audio: Use no sound by default and pause when backgrounded/interrupted
